Welcome to DataTester! This article introduces the operation of adding members, authorizing roles, etc. that need to be completed by the administrator role before using the DataTester product for the first time, as well as the operation guidance of subsequent experimenters and developers, to help you quickly start the A/B experiment journey!

<span id="dc590dea"></span>
# Step 1: Log into the DataTester console

After the installation and deployment of the privatized environment is completed, you need to contact the operation and maintenance staff to obtain the administrator account and product login link, log in to the privatized environment with the administrator account password, and enter the product console of DataTester.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/2ca3d8a43c10479b9b5ddf5880547907~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

After logging in to the console home page of the privatized environment, you can switch products in the upper left corner to enter the DataTester console, or directly click on the product service in the upper right corner to enter the DataTester console.

<span id="26232d2d"></span>
# Step 2: Create a user and authorize

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">DataTester privatization environment user and role permissions control operation entry and details related to DataTester privatization version, this article takes the 4.9.0 version as an example to introduce the basic process for you. 4.9.0 and above versions can refer to this article, historical versions can refer to <a href="https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/User-and-Permission-Management-Overview">User and Permission Management Overview</a>.</div>


<span id="0d5fa5a5"></span>
## 1. Understand basic information

In the privatization environment of DataTester, it provides you with several user rights control dimensions such as group, project, enterprise department organization, and product function. You need to plan the rights control dimensions of the business according to actual business needs.


|Dimensional segmentation |Detailed description |Planning example |
|---|---|---|
|Group and group administrators |* The group is the division of product use management capabilities, and the management and use capabilities of a set of products are divided into multiple sets through the "group" and distributed to different sub\-businesses for use.<br><br>* Under each group, there are independent "projects, users, departments, roles", that is, the permissions under each group can be independently managed and authorized. |The enterprise has multiple sub\-businesses, which are completely independent of each other (including personnel changes, organizational structure, rights management, data analytics, etc.).<br><br><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," /> |
|Projects and project administrators |* Project management is a resource group management method provided by BytePlus, which allows you to manage data resources used by different businesses or projects in groups, isolating and authorizing them based on the project. |If the company has multiple projects, the business data of each project is managed separately, making it easy to view, analyze, and manage the actual operation of each project<br><br><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," /> |
|Corporate sector |The enterprise department is mainly an organizational form of users, organizing users in a departmental structure, which can be used in scenarios such as authorization ||
|DataTester Features |Perform permission control for DataTester product segmentation functions for roles, such as viewing and editing permission refinement of experimental management function modules. ||


In addition, as an administrator, you need to understand the rights management policy of DataTester. DataTester's rights system is a role\-based rights management design (RBAC), which indirectly grants users permissions by means of user\-associated roles and role\-associated permissions.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

Therefore, you need to create corresponding users and roles according to the business plan, and complete authorization operations for user roles.

<span id="08d49497"></span>
## 2. Enter the Management Center


* First login to a privatized environment.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/3bc714d972f2432989733b1d7586e3bf~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

* Other entrances

   You can hover the mouse over the account name logged in in the upper right corner, click **Management Center** in the displayed window, and enter the Management Center page.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/20dd7ec38c404a3db03dca279054f96e~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


On the management center page, you can see the basic information of the current group, and perform all project management, user and rights management operations at the group level.

<span id="4969cd61"></span>
## 3. Create a user

You can create users in the **Admin Center** \> **Users and Organizations** \> **User Management** page.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/bbebf34bf836429f84dca2f51a2ce624~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="472511a5"></span>
## 4. Create roles and associate members

You can create roles on the **Admin Center** \> **Users and Organizations** \> **Role Management** page, and add authorized users to roles during role creation.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4c8566d575974922bc69d6fed84c9f08~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="cef9b915"></span>
## 5. Delegate roles

You can authorize roles in the **Admin Center** \> **Permissions Granted** \> **By Role** page.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5e566956bfb34f3890768af9ce146ee4~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


* You can click the Console and Product Name tabs at the top of the page to grant the roles subdivision permissions for the console and product features, respectively.

* After clicking Edit to modify permissions and saving, all member users of the role have permissions for the role.


<span id="1913f2c3"></span>
# Step 3: Create a new project and bind the application

Project administrators can create projects and bind applications. After completion, they can conduct A/B experiments on the applications later.

You can create a new project in the **Management Center** \> **Project Management** page. After completion, on the project list page, click **Enter Products** under the A/B Test Platform column to bind the application of A/B testing to the project.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/fc35ef605c6a41f9b4ec344dc9fb99e6~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="dea9e65e"></span>
# Other administrator\-related operations


* Global Settings for DataTester: When conducting A/B experiments, some common application\-level configurations and configuration parameters that can be applied to all experiments in the application can be configured in the global settings of DataTester.

* After the experiment is carried out, the administrator can view the basic operation of the management experiment in the management pages, such as data and tasks provided by DataTester.
